metadata.title: Green Sand Computed-Mixture Near-Infrared Spectral Library v1.0.0
metadata.description: 4,410 computed near-infrared reflectance spectra of dry foundry green sand (3-12% bentonite, 0-5% seacoal, 0-2% red iron oxide, silica sand balance), 1000-2350 nm at 1 nm and at the resolution of a 1000-2350 nm InGaAs instrument (195 channels). Computed by Hapke single-scattering-albedo mixing of USGS Spectral Library Version 7 spectra, with seacoal and iron oxide effective particle sizes calibrated to 24 measured dry mixtures (Kuubata 2025). Includes codebook, mixing rules, QA report and provenance log.
